coverage_summary: Lane gates_integrity, subject commit 9dd22f259d164ebb1afde3b8940a891161cad3f6 (tree 1532c116b1e2bf9ee23c38f159a615769f34f802). git rev-parse HEAD returned the pinned subject at review start; HEAD then advanced during the session to 402c9c46 via two post-freeze receipts-only commits (cf5de0e, 402c9c4) — verified `git diff 9dd22f2..402c9c4 -- scripts tests daemon kernel desktop runtime protocols config nemesis.gpr alire.toml` is empty, so every source/script/test file read from the worktree is byte-identical to the frozen subject. Audited: verify_authority_aba.py (new A→B→A authority tamper gate), verify_proof_aba.py (copy-anchor change), verify_kernel_proof.py + validate_production_readiness.py (SEALED_LOCAL_PRODUCTION addition) + tests/integration/test_production_readiness.py, generate/verify_phase16_receipt.py (epoch v0.2.0-trust-surface move), and test_authority.sh/test_storage.sh wiring. CONFIRMED: (1) the B mutation is a genuine compiling authority widening — `Consume_Result not in Approval_Accepted | Approval_Replayed` (verify_authority_aba.py:26-29) against the unique anchor daemon/src/nemesis_core_daemon.adb:411, with Approval_Replayed a real Consume_Result_Kind literal (kernel/src/nemesis-kernel-approvals.ads:18-19); harness fails closed on non-compiling mutation (:153-155), on B passing or lacking failure markers (:156-160), on non-byte-identical restoration (:162-165), and on subject-inventory drift (:173-175); archived B.log shows the hostile test failing on exactly the replay assertion ('OK' != 'REFUSED', FAILED (failures=1)), and all six A/B/A2 log hashes match both receipts. (2) No-op satisfaction impossible: a missing/misspelled hostile test module fails run A (exit!=0 at :136-138) before B is ever evaluated; B acceptance requires nonzero exit AND unittest failure markers; proof ABA additionally requires the intended GNATprove reason (verify_proof_aba.py:132-136) and PASS_KERNEL_PROOF_BASELINE in A/A2 (:114-116). (3) SEALED_LOCAL_PRODUCTION is fail-closed against empty roster (lanes non-empty :237-238, required-lane roster :265-266) and status omission (:253-254 + overall-derivation cross-check :273-275); requires every lane PASS, automatable_complete=true, explicit Developer ID/notarization/Gatekeeper nonclaims, and only EXTERNAL required_for_verdict=false blockers (:322-348), all regression-tested in test_production_readiness.py:148-189 and hostile-calibrated in test_hostile_calibration.sh. (4) Phase-16 epoch move is a two-string change with generator and verifier in exact agreement (v0.2.0-trust-surface at generate:119/verify:22); for the gate-wired receipt (receipts/phase-16-public/PHASE16.json, epoch present, hash matches INPUTS pin) subject ancestor/tree, covered-source diff, dirty-tree, artifact hashes, sentinels, FAIL_/FATAL_/REFUSED_ scan, and guest-cleanup fields are all enforced (verify_phase16_receipt.py:136-227). (5) Wiring: test_authority.sh and test_storage.sh run under set -euo pipefail with each new gate (verify_proof_aba.py, verify_authority_aba.py, nemesis_authority_store_tests) as a bare command line whose failure aborts the script; nemesis_authority_store_tests is a declared Main/Executable in nemesis.gpr:14,25-26 built by build_ada.sh. GAPS: one medium (GIN-01, ABA receipts stamp rev-parse HEAD with no dirty-tree capture — demonstrated at the frozen subject, whose committed ABA receipts misattribute the TS-modified worktree to baseline commit 4f0f387) and three low (GIN-02 optional-epoch verification downgrade, GIN-03 self-referential trust-surface contract binding in verify_kernel_proof, GIN-04/GIN-05 SEALED semantic seams). Verdict: GAPS.

confirmed_invariants: Authority ABA mutation is a genuine, compiling authority widening: `Consume_Result not in Approval_Accepted | Approval_Replayed` (scripts/verify_authority_aba.py:26-29) accepts replayed approvals at the unique anchor daemon/src/nemesis_core_daemon.adb:411; Approval_Replayed is a Consume_Result_Kind literal (kernel/src/nemesis-kernel-approvals.ads:18-19); anchor uniqueness enforced at runtime (verify_authority_aba.py:143-145) and a subject already containing the widening would fail the anchor count.

Authority ABA harness is fail-closed at every seam: non-compiling mutation → FAIL mutation_does_not_compile (:153-155); B exiting 0 or lacking unittest failure markers → FAIL widening_not_rejected (:156-160); byte-restoration verified against full pre-run copy inventory (:162-165); A2 must exit 0 (:167-171); subject-tree inventory compared before/after the whole gate (:126, :173-175); the gate operates only in a TemporaryDirectory copy and build_ada.sh derives ROOT from its own copied location, so builds land in the copy.

No-op satisfaction impossible: a missing/misspelled hostile test module makes run A exit nonzero (FAIL initial_A, :136-138) before B; B only runs the single named hostile test, so its failure is attributable; archived B.log confirms the intended rejection ('OK' != 'REFUSED', FAILED (failures=1)); stale receipt and logs are deleted before any run (:120-123) so a crashed run leaves no PASS artifacts; receipt is written atomically only after all checks (:216-218).

Proof ABA intended-reason discipline: B must exit nonzero AND contain a GNATprove postcondition failure (verify_proof_aba.py:132-136); A/A2 require PASS_KERNEL_PROOF_BASELINE (:114-116, emitted by scripts/prove_kernel.sh:38 only after verify_kernel_proof.py succeeds); archived B.log shows 'nemesis-kernel-capabilities.ads:55:11: high: postcondition might fail'.

Proof ABA copy-anchor change is correct and fail-closed: TS_CONTINUATION_CONTRACT_2026-08-22.md added to COPY_FILES (verify_proof_aba.py:22-26) because validate_live_scope resolves authorized_by.contract relative to the copy root (verify_kernel_proof.py:201-213); omitting it would fail run A, never fail open.

SEALED_LOCAL_PRODUCTION cannot be reached by omission: empty lanes → 'lanes must be a non-empty array' (validate_production_readiness.py:237-238) plus 'required lane set missing' (:265-266); omitted/invalid lane status → 'status is invalid' (:253-254); declared overall must equal derived overall which requires non-empty all-PASS statuses (:88-100, :268-275); SEALED additionally requires every lane PASS, automatable_complete=true, Developer ID/notarization/Gatekeeper nonclaims present, and only EXTERNAL required_for_verdict=false blockers (:322-348); regression-tested (tests/integration/test_production_readiness.py:148-189) and hostile-calibrated including python -O assert-stripping (scripts/test_hostile_calibration.sh).

Phase-16 epoch move: generator and verifier agree exactly (generate_phase16_receipt.py:119 sets epoch v0.2.0-trust-surface; verify_phase16_receipt.py:22 requires it when present); baseline→subject diff is only the two epoch strings, so no source-binding check was weakened; for the gate-wired receipt (receipts/phase-16-public/PHASE16.json, epoch present, sha256 0de52b82 matching the INPUTS pin at subject and at HEAD) the verifier enforces subject existence+ancestry (:130-137), tree equality (:138-140), covered-source diff emptiness (:141-149), artifact set+digests (:151-163), sentinels and FAIL_/FATAL_/REFUSED_ absence in the actual log (:173-203), guest cleanup fields (:168-172), and covered-source cleanliness (:219-227); the generator independently refuses logs missing sentinels or containing failure markers (generate_phase16_receipt.py:60-68) and pins the release-contract identity by hardcoded hash (:26-30); orchestrator cleanup is evidence-backed since an orphaned guest emits FATAL_SECURITY_GUEST_ORPHANED and exits nonzero (scripts/run_security_hardening.sh:31-38).

Gate wiring propagates failures: scripts/test_authority.sh:2 and scripts/test_storage.sh:2 use `set -euo pipefail`; verify_proof_aba.py, verify_authority_aba.py (test_authority.sh:14-16) and nemesis_authority_store_tests (test_authority.sh:10, test_storage.sh:11) are bare command lines, so any nonzero exit aborts before the PASS marker; nemesis_authority_store_tests is a declared Main with explicit Executable in nemesis.gpr:14,25-26, built into build/bin by scripts/build_ada.sh, and the stale-binary risk is nil because build_ada.sh runs first in both scripts.

ABA receipt/log integrity at rest: recomputed sha256 of all six archived A/B/A2 logs match their receipts; both receipts at the frozen subject match the INPUTS-20260822.json gate_artifact pins exactly (AUTHORITY_ABA 0c03402b..., PROOF_ABA 53f925ed...).

findings.summary: verify_authority_aba.py and verify_proof_aba.py stamp `subject.commit`/`subject.tree` from `git rev-parse HEAD` at receipt-write time without recording or refusing a dirty working tree. The gate audits worktree bytes (the disposable copy is made from the worktree), so when the worktree differs from HEAD the receipt attributes the run to the wrong commit. This is not theoretical: the AUTHORITY_ABA.json and PROOF_ABA.json committed INSIDE the frozen subject 9dd22f2 declare subject.commit=4f0f387 (the pre-trust-surface baseline, observed_at 13:55Z) although the harness demonstrably exercised the TS-001 code (the mutation anchor `if Consume_Result /= Approval_Accepted` only exists at 9dd22f2, and B.log shows the TS-001 hostile replay test failing). Only source_inventory_sha256 truthfully binds the audited bytes. The sibling verify_kernel_proof.py already solves this by stamping `dirty_paths` from `git status --porcelain` into its receipt.
findings.title: ABA receipts bind commit/tree via bare `git rev-parse HEAD` with no dirty-tree capture — provenance misattribution demonstrated at the frozen subject
